semantics_note: LogicNLI defines Paradox/self_contradiction when both s and not-s are derivable. The dual-proof decision checks both proof directions instead of stopping after one supported path.
implementation_note: The reproducible evaluator uses LogicNLI's official structured test_logic representation. It implements forward implication/equivalence, conjunction/disjunction antecedents, universal-variable templates, named constants, and existential antecedents; disjunctive or existential consequents are conservative. This is not an end-to-end natural-language comparison with BERT/RoBERTa/XLNet.
